component.name: Uninstall Plus
component.summary: See and uninstall RPM packages and Flatpak apps
Visualiser et désinstaller les paquets RPM et les applications Flatpak

description.p: Uninstall Plus lists everything installed on your Fedora system, including software that was installed from the command line, and lets you remove it.
Uninstall Plus liste tout ce qui est installé sur votre système Fedora, y compris les logiciels installés en ligne de commande, et vous permet de les supprimer.

ul.li: All RPM packages with their description and origin repository
Filter by repository or show only the packages you installed yourself
See exactly what DNF will remove before uninstalling a package
Flatpak applications, with unused runtimes cleaned up automatically
Add, remove, enable and disable DNF repositories, COPR projects and Flatpak remotes
English and French interface, light and dark themes

screenshot.caption: Installed RPM packages with their origin repository
